title: Frobenius functors and one-sided Hopf algebras in braided monoidal categories
summary: Evidence suggests a tight connection between the existence of antipode-like maps on bialgebra-like structures, and the Frobenius property for the associated free Hopf module functor. In this paper, we prove that in any braided monoidal category satisfying few mild assumptions, a bimonoid is a one-sided Hopf monoid and the antipode is a bimonoid anti-homomorphism, if and only if the free Hopf module functor is Frobenius.
